summary.source: evidence/state-handler-events.json (capstone static scan of 1031 DNF.exe on-disk text segment)
summary.note: ATK selector first immediate arg = attack index into the skill's .atk resource; proves which attack volume a state launches. Geometry is read from PVF .atk; this is the exe->PVF dispatch link. The selector sits in a Themida VM region, so the immediate is recorded as-is (not yet translated to a .atk file name).
summary.attribution_caveat: On-disk handlers are many-to-one for shared states; those groups carry shared_handler=true because only the runtime skill_id selector picks the concrete .atk.
